https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/fatty-repl.title: Fatty-replaced breast tissue
content: Fatty-replaced breast tissue is a term used in mammography that refers to the replacement of breast tissue with fatty tissue. This commonly occurs as a person ages.
This article incorporates public domain material from Dictionary of Cancer Terms. U.S. National Cancer Institute.
